name: VideoGen MCP
description: Create editable videos from storyboards, scripts or voiceovers, generate media, edit projects and export results through the VideoGen API; account and generation credits required. Hosted HTTP with OAuth/API key or local stdio via `npx -y @videogen/mcp@2.2.1` with `VIDEOGEN_API_KEY`; MIT server; [Setup](https://videogen.io/videogen-mcp).
